q: What is the key rule that makes the 7-day plan succeed?
options: Do every integration in one day
One thing per day — compounding beats cramming
Build in whatever order seems fun
explanation: One thing per day compounds: each small win builds on the last so by Day 7 you have a working, secure, automated agent.

q: On which day does the agent reach your phone?
explanation: By Day 3 you connect Telegram so the agent is genuinely useful on the move.

q: When should you apply the security checklist?
explanation: Hardening belongs on Day 7 as the last step, so your always-on agent is secure before you rely on it.

q: What is the Week-1 plan best summed up as?
options: Install, personalise, pocket, email, automate, scale, harden
Do all labs in an afternoon
explanation: The week is: install → make it yours → phone access → email → automate → real-scale work → harden and review.
